summary: BugPin is a self-hosted tool designed for logging and managing software defects within web applications. It provides a visual interface to help teams track issues and organise tickets related to user-facing or backend failures. Because the official details are sparse, it functions like standard issue-tracking software tailored for web development workflows.
goodFor: It suits small development teams or solo maintainers who want an open-source ticketing system deployed locally rather than relying on third-party SaaS bug trackers.
watchOut: With a modest repository size and slowing maintenance activity, updates may be infrequent and community support will likely be limited compared to mainstream alternatives.
deployNotes: As a containerised application, deployment typically requires Docker along with persistent volumes for data storage and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
